key_insight: AnchorLoop adds a frozen previous executor as a historical reference, preventing self-training feedback from collapsing when the current model becomes over-consistent.
engineering_relevance: This gives tool-integrated agents a lightweight, no-external-label way to sustain learning signals across iterations in automated reasoning systems.
method: Freeze the previous iteration’s Executor as an anchor/reference model.
Use the anchor to compute cross-reference advantages for Executor reinforcement learning.
Reuse the anchor during Curriculum training to score agreement differences for task selection.
evidence_signal: Across 13 reasoning benchmarks, the method improves over Agent0 by 2.5% on mathematical reasoning and 2.8% on general reasoning, with stronger late-iteration gains.
watch_item: Because the anchor matches the Executor during Curriculum training, its agreement signal is only a proxy for task usefulness, not proof of correctness or true improvement.
paper_title: Self-Evolve With a Reference:Anchored Training of Tool-Integrated Agents
